client_brief:
Four-second product launch edit and a consistent eight-bowl photo set

Ironwood Kitchen has one short product clip available for this commission. Please build a deliberate edit of no more than four seconds, not a longer launch film assembled from material we have not supplied.

The photographic side is equally important: eight bowls need a shared bright treatment and usable crops for both the tiles and the line sheet. Removing a reference card must not clip the bowl itself.

A deliberate 4-second-or-shorter edit assembled from the 1 supplied short clip using an explicit timeline, plus one platform reframe and three checked poster frames. Source time ranges must come from motion_source_metadata.json and a task-specific edit decision list. The supplied video files contain no audio streams; use a separate supplied WAV only where one exists and never infer dialogue from silent footage.

Eight bowl masters brought to one bright house target, one white point, one black point, one brightness and one crop logic, delivered at both the tile ratio and the line sheet picture ratio, with no grey card anywhere in frame and no bowl clipped by the crop that removed it. Per frame parameter log, including one line on why each frame differs from its neighbours and which cards could not be trusted.

The inputs are source_video_files/ (1 measured short file); motion_source_metadata.json; ironwood_bowls/ (8 stills, 6000 x 4000); ironwood_linesheet_2027.pdf; ironwood_skus.csv; ironwood_wordmark.png; ironwood_notes.txt.

Media inventory: 1 video files, 5.042 seconds in total; 0 with embedded audio; 0 separate audio files (0 seconds). These measured sources set the production limits.

Use the source metadata for the actual time ranges and provide an edit decision list. The video is silent; do not infer spoken content. Separate supplied audio may be used only if the pack contains it. Please check all three poster frames rather than exporting near-identical or poorly timed stills without review.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and the final edit decision list and measured source metadata. Include an inventory showing how every supplied file was used or why it was set aside. Keep factual content tied to the approved inputs. Any missing coverage, substituted asset, reconciliation or quality compromise must be declared; a weak source is not permission to invent or silently replace it. Keep runtime within measured source duration and the stated cap; do not invent footage or dialogue.

Please work within $2,500-$6,500 fixed and the 2 to 4 weeks target. Allow for one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork recurring role posting for a creative partner serving meal prep and caterer businesses, quoted in the ledger grounding_note, whose listed deliverable scope was short form video ads, vertical short form and feed video content, product showcase videos and video resizing or adaptation, plus the graphic design line items paid social ads, website banners and assets, branding assets and promotional creatives, with turnaround weighted as the success metric. That posting is a retainer shaped list rather than one job, so the honest fuller commission is the launch it exists to service: one product line going live at once on the counter, on the delivery tiles, in the drivers' printed sheet and in paid social. The post names no client, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional brand Ironwood Kitchen. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) is what makes the printed half real rather than asserted: a printer's press PDF converts into a live InDesign merge template headlessly, so the client's own last season artwork becomes the template rather than something invented, and HTML authoring returns a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, which is what the weekly rotating caption card actually needs.

price_band_and_audience: Twelve dollar grab and go bowls, buyer 24 to 45 on an office lunch run with about eleven minutes to spend. The band is load bearing: at this price the work has to read bright, high key, clean and fast, food photographed close to how it looks in the case under fridge light, type large and plain, one claim per card. The same eight bowls at a thirty two dollar chef counter band would correctly be graded down, shot warmer and darker with negative space and small quiet type, and shipping that treatment here reads slow and expensive and empties a lunch rush. Push the other way into saturated primaries, drop shadows and burst badges and it becomes a mall food court, which contradicts the macro led claim the whole line is sold on. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Real lunch, in the case by half ten
brand_identity.sector: Fast casual grab and go: high protein meal prep bowls sold from a counter case and by office park delivery.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2019, Providence, Rhode Island, two counters and three office park delivery routes run by a small kitchen crew.
brand_identity.about: Ironwood Kitchen builds honest, high protein bowls for the office lunch run, in the fridge case by mid morning and gone by early afternoon. We are a working kitchen, not a tasting room. The promise is simple: food you would actually eat at your desk, twelve dollars, nothing invented and nothing dressed up.
brand_identity.audience: Office workers 24 to 45 on a weekday lunch run with roughly eleven minutes to spend, buying on macros, speed and trust rather than on spectacle.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Twelve dollars a bowl, the everyday middle of grab and go. Above a supermarket meal deal, well below a chef counter. We are not a tasting menu and never pretend to be one.
brand_identity.typography: One plain, high legibility grotesque sans carries everything, set large and tight. Names and prices sit big and quiet, one claim per card, no scripts and no display flourish. The type should read from arm's length in a fridge case.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, warm, counter honest, one thought per line. Example: "Twelve bucks, in the case by half ten, gone by two. That is the whole promise."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand kit survives. The wordmark exists only as a flat picture on a white ground, exported by a designer who has since left, with no vector file and no source anywhere. Everything else is a photograph or a spreadsheet.
brand_identity.values: Feed people well and tell the truth about what is in the bowl. The allergen line and the macros are not marketing, they are the deal.

assets_supplied.name: ironwood_bowls/ (8 stills, 6000 x 4000)
assets_supplied.kind: Top down product photography on the steel bench, one bowl per frame, grey card propped at the back edge of every frame.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All eight, same bench, same card in every one so you can set the colour."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two frames were shot after the roller blind went up, so the card in those carries mixed daylight and tungsten and neutralising to it takes the kale and the salsa verde a dead grey green, while on a third the card sits inside the bowl's own shadow. On three frames the card overlaps the plate area, so a crop that removes the card also removes part of the bowl unless the crop is re thought per frame.

assets_supplied.name: ironwood_linesheet_2027.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press PDF of last season's line sheet, one SKU per page, name, description, macros, allergen line and price, with a placed product photograph on each page.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Last season's sheet, straight back from the printer. Same shape, new bowls."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The SKU block converts to one continuous text flow rather than separate frames, and the mapping readout silently drops the allergen run while keeping its line break, so every offset past it is short by exactly that run's length and the validator still reports the mapping VALID. The document also carries no bleed, which cannot be introduced later.

assets_supplied.name: ironwood_skus.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The new season roster: bowl name, description, macro line, allergen line, price, and an image column naming the picture for each row.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The eight new bowls with the picture names against them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It holds nine rows for eight bowls because a discontinued bowl was never deleted, and one description runs about forty percent longer than the rest, which the fixed frame does not spill: it simply stops rendering and truncates that record at trim.

assets_supplied.name: ironwood_wordmark.png
assets_supplied.kind: Flat export of the wordmark, dark letters on a white ground, no vector file anywhere.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All we have of the logo. The designer who made it has gone."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The letters are disjoint, so a one call knockout collapses the mark to two surviving letterforms while reporting success, and a trace returns geometry with no viewBox and an opaque full canvas ground path riding underneath it.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which visible beats in the measured short clips actually cut together without a continuity jump, duplicate action, or missing subject.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Filenames and source duration do not establish visual continuity. The first assembled proof is the earliest reliable evidence.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Replace or reorder source ranges, shorten the piece, and rebuild the EDL around the strongest continuous action.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A technically valid render feels accidental or implies an action that the source never completes.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the approved horizontal composition survives the required vertical or square reframe with the subject and essential interface or product detail still visible.

emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Choose a different source range for the platform version or use fit instead of fill and revise the surrounding design treatment.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The platform export is correctly sized but loses the person, product, or interface that gives the shot meaning.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the silent final piece still communicates clearly without implying dialogue, ambience, or music that was never supplied.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: This can be judged only on the final rendered sequence, not from a successful operation response.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Strengthen visual sequencing or approved on-screen copy without fabricating a soundtrack.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The deliverable relies on absent sound and fails when viewed as supplied.
